Fixed the helper-name collision in `packages/babel-helpers/src/index.ts:194`. Helper-local bindings now avoid the identifier the helper itself will be bound to, so the internal `set` function becomes `__set` instead of colliding with the exported `_set` helper and recursing infinitely.

Validated:
- `babel-helpers` suite: 12 passed
- `transform-classes` + `transform-object-super` suites: 223 passed
- Manual `let set` class transform no longer produces the recursive `_set` helper.
